title: Forge module manifest
description: Declares a Forge module's identity, ownership and explicit dependencies. Lives as forge-module.json in the module project root. Composition remains explicit in startup code (ADR 01); the manifest is inspectable metadata, never an activation mechanism.

id.description: Stable module identifier, e.g. 'Forge.ReferenceCatalog'. Only official Forge packages use the Forge namespace (ADR 36).

dependencies.description: Ids of modules this module depends on. The graph must be acyclic; forge modules validate enforces this.

ownedSchemas.description: Database schemas owned exclusively by this module (ADR 03). No other module may reference them.
